question: Does explicit 2D local refinement after stage3 SSM processing improve segmentation; does image-conditioned channel weighting add value over the same convolution?

changes.cab: Native MambaIR CAB(384,compress_ratio3,squeeze_factor30) on real16x16 norm2 features after last stage3 Mamba mixer; zero-initialized384channel residual scale; parallel to original MLP.
changes.conv_control: Exact same two3x3 convolutions and GELU, identical initial convolution weights; replace channel attention with constant0.5. Same location and residual scale.

insertion: encoder.model.levels[2].blocks[3].mlp output hook; input is norm2(post-SSM residual), before subsequent Attention blocks
mapping: Use original native window_reverse to28x28, crop real16x16, apply local module, zero-pad back28x28, native window_partition14. No processing of artificial padding in CAB.
original_encoder: Official MambaVision-S ImageNet initialization; original SSM equations, all MLPs, original14/7windows retained; only stages3/4 and adapter trainable, encoder.eval.
initialization: Original encoder/head states and logits exactly match reference; native CAB init isolated CPU seed142; residual scale exactly0.

training.precision: BF16_forward_FP32_loss; residual cast back to common dtype

reference: Reuse Stage45 UPer64 after exact762validation replay; both new runs start from official ImageNet weights.
selection: Max validation macroDice earliesttie; complete100epochs; full867test for every fixedbest checkpoint after both trainings.

evidence.stage49: Both PEFT arms failed validation screen; retain stronger late-full-tuned baseline.
evidence.baseline_validation_errors: 21 severe-undercoverage cases; FN1,341,495 and FP1,057,139; mixed errors do not establish local forgetting as cause.
evidence.implementation: Native MambaVision uses1D depthwise convolution inside flattened windows; explicit2D refinement is an untested hypothesis, not absence of spatial context.
evidence.prior_scope: Prior CFAM was decoder stride8 refinement; this insertion is inside encoder before Attention. Cross-stage comparison does not isolate location from module.

controls: Identical convolution architecture and initialization, same spatial mapping and residual scale; channel-attention arm has9612more parameters, not strictly parameter/FLOP matched.
caveats: Module adaptation, not full MambaIR reproduction or new CAB invention.
No change to SSM state update equation; this is a Mamba-block spatial branch.
Single seed and single location; no claim all spatial alternatives are exhausted if negative.
Rank8 PEFT failure does not exclude other PEFT ranks, learning rates or placements.
Repeatedly exposed test cannot support a new untouched-test claim.
